start.title: Tangent Universe Alignment
start.description: Artifact drop detected. Primary timeline split initiated.

accept.title: The Artifact Returns
accept.description: Donnie stays in his bed and accepts the engine drop, closing the loop.

resist.title: Timeline Collapse
resist.description: The tangent universe destabilizes and consumes reality.

start.title: Cold Air Phenomenon
start.description: Unexplained temperature drop across environments. Patient reports seeing the dead.

investigate.title: The Revelation
investigate.description: Malcolm realizes he is one of the ghosts Cole sees.

dismiss.title: Unresolved Spirits
dismiss.description: Malcolm remains trapped in denial, haunting his wife forever.

start.title: Travis Bickle's Vigil
start.description: An insomniac ex-Marine drives through the neon-drenched streets of New York City, growing increasingly disgusted by social decay.

isolation.title: The Desert of Isolation
isolation.description: Travis retreats entirely inside his apartment, writing intense manifests while his psychological stability fractures.

arsenal.title: The Decisive Intervention
arsenal.description: Armed and physically transformed, Travis stalks the city streets looking for a target to enact his twisted vision of salvation.

start.title: The 15-Year Confinement
start.description: Oh Dae-su is inexplicably abducted and imprisoned inside a sealed hotel room for fifteen years with no explanation.

vengeance.title: The Corridor Conflict
vengeance.description: Armed with a hammer, Dae-su fights through rows of guards to extract blood confessions from his jailers.

puzzle.title: The Mastermind's Deception
puzzle.description: Dae-su traces the complex clues left behind by Lee Woo-jin, walking directly into a trap built out of his own history.

start.title: Cryptic Cyphers
start.description: Unverified correspondence received by major newspapers claiming responsibility for unsolved murders.

choices.label: Publish the cipher on the front page

publish.title: Public Panic
publish.description: The cipher is published, causing widespread fear but generating thousands of tips—one of which might be the key.

withhold.title: The Killer Escalates
withhold.description: Enraged by the lack of attention, the killer strikes again to force the police's hand.
